privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Kachizaka is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. Your account, your leagues and your predictions are kept in Kachizaka's database in Canada, visible to the members of your leagues. Match facts come from a sports data feed through Orazaka, Krizaka's engine; nothing about you is sent there. There is no money, no payment and no advertising. Nothing is sold or shared. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.
